description: Whether the summarizer's answer is spoken (spec #100 slice 2.5, ticket #160): the answer trimmed of .whitespacesAndNewlines is used only when it is not empty and is shorter than max(200, reply.count / 2) Characters (integer division on the untrimmed reply's extended grapheme clusters, strict). Otherwise, as for no answer at all, the full reply is spoken. Markdown is not stripped here; spokenReply does that afterwards with no length cap.
function: SummaryService.usableSummary(_:for:) — input {summary, reply} with summary a text descriptor or null and reply a text descriptor, expected the summary that is spoken (a text descriptor) or null
verifiedBy: DESIGN.md v1.12, v2.14; Tests/PowerUpTests/SpeechFixtureTests.swift testSummaryAcceptanceTable plays it through SummaryService.usableSummary(_:for:).
capturedAgainst: Swift 5.9.2 Foundation and NaturalLanguage (Xcode 15.2) on macOS 27.2, PowerUp at 67659a4

cases.name: no summary falls back
cases.reason: A failed or timed-out summarizer gives nil and the full reply is spoken (HK-171).

cases.name: an empty summary falls back
cases.reason: An empty answer is a failure (HK-170).

cases.name: a whitespace summary falls back
cases.reason: An answer that trims to nothing is a failure (HK-170).

cases.name: a short summary is used trimmed
cases.reason: A usable summary is spoken trimmed of whitespace and newlines (HK-170).

cases.name: 199 Characters against a short reply is used
cases.reason: max(200, reply.count / 2) is 200 for a short reply, and 199 is under it (HK-170).

cases.name: 200 Characters against a short reply falls back
half the reply minus one is used
cases.reason: For a long reply the limit is half its length (HK-170).

cases.name: half the reply falls back
cases.reason: A summary half as long as the reply is not short enough (HK-170).

cases.name: half of an odd reply rounds down
half of an odd reply rounds down, one under
the summary is measured after trimming
cases.reason: Padding around the summary does not count (HK-170).

cases.name: the reply is measured untrimmed
cases.reason: The reply's own whitespace counts toward the limit: 602 / 2 is 301 (HK-170).

cases.name: the reply length counts Characters
cases.reason: 600 emoji Characters make a limit of 300, not one from their scalars or UTF-16 units (HK-173).

cases.name: a summary as long as a short reply is used
cases.reason: The limit is max(200, reply.count / 2), so a short reply's summary may be as long as the reply and still be used (HK-170).

cases.name: markdown in the summary is kept here
cases.reason: Acceptance does not strip markdown; spokenReply does that afterwards with no length cap (HK-171).
